title: Anthropic's New Auto-Grader Fixed My Agent's Broken .docx
description:
My agent shipped a busted .docx three times last week. Then Anthropic fixed it — you can now hand Claude a plain-English checklist of what 'done' looks like, and a second Claude grades the work before it lands on your desk.

No code. You write the checklist in plain English. If the slide deck is missing a section, or the report misses the point, the grader spots it and tells the first agent to try again — until it passes.

The lift Anthropic reported: ten percent more tasks land on the first try, jumping eleven percent on PowerPoints and eight percent on Word docs. No extra fee.

If your AI builds reports, slides, or emails — anything where 'good enough' isn't — this is the upgrade that catches the bad version before you ever see it.

🔗 Full breakdown: https://avinashsangle.com/blog/claude-managed-agents-outcomes
